policy: A capability is certified only by executed provider-specific evidence. Source presence, expression construction, and a configured CI job are not passing evidence. Native AOT warning classification is diagnostic evidence only; no warning count is treated as a passing certification result. The .NET ORM provider track contains EF Core only.

statusVocabulary.implemented: Code path exists; not a claim of provider certification.
statusVocabulary.implemented-opt-in: Code path exists but capability is not enabled by the default provider profile.
statusVocabulary.groundwork-only: Partial primitives exist; complete capability is not implemented.
statusVocabulary.test-defined-not-run: A test and CI command are present; no successful execution result is asserted by this source manifest.
statusVocabulary.release-gate-blocked: The aggregate release gate fails unless every expected lane is present, provenance-valid, internally consistent, and all required EF Core RIDs are certified.
statusVocabulary.disabled: Runtime validation gate must remain closed.
statusVocabulary.diagnostic-configured-not-run: A warning-capture and classification step is configured in CI but has not been executed; it is not publish or runtime evidence.
statusVocabulary.warning-gate-configured-not-run: CI runs unit tests for the ownership classifier and configures a blocking EF Core IL2026/IL3050 policy; this source manifest does not assert that the workflow has run or passed.
statusVocabulary.certified-for-rid: Provider-specific Native AOT publish, native execution, and required warning-baseline checks passed for the recorded runtime identifier in an executed CI run.
statusVocabulary.incomplete-or-failed: A provider/RID Native AOT evidence record exists, but one or more required certification checks did not pass.
